mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to reduced risk-free discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in at least 70% of similar FEDFUNDS > 5.25% trigger events, or the 5-day moving average of 20-day returns fails to diverge from zero.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly UNRATE falls by more than 0.2 percentage points over a 2-month window, it coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower expected labor costs boost corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp over the prior two months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of UNRATE decline events of similar magnitude, or the 5-year rolling correlation between UNRATE changes and 60-day returns is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST of at least 3% followed by a rebound above the prior month's level predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals a bottom in industrial demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops ≥3% in month t and rises in month t+1
failure_condition: No significant excess returns in 20-day windows following such HOUST patterns compared to baseline, or the pattern recurs less than 5% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates softening supply conditions that, when combined with a rising GDPC1, produce a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates demand recovery.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 for two months AND GDPC1 > previous month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive in 60% of INDPRO < 100 double-month events with rising GDPC1, or the interaction coefficient is not significant at the 5% level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL of at least 0.3% for three consecutive months predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as it signals persistent inflation pressure and tighter policy anticipation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases by ≥0.3% per month for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >60% of such CPIAUCSL declines, or the 3-month CPIAUCSL trend is not predictive in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS rises by more than 2% in a single month, it reflects strong job creation and supports a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as confidence in labor market expansion boosts equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >2% in month t
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in 70% of PAYEMS >2% single-month events, or the effect is spurious in rolling window tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in RSAFS by 5% and a rise in GDPC1 by 2% in the same month predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals improved demand for final goods while production is expanding.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS ↓5% AND GDPC1 ↑2% in the same month
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day returns in 70% of such co-moving events, or the interaction p-value exceeds 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months in a non-recession regime, it predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as lower borrowing costs ease financing constraints for capital expenditure.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for two consecutive months and not during a recession month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive in 60% of such UNRATE declines outside recession months, or the effect is not robust to alternative rate regimes.
